svg.text: Unit = circle radius (R). Circle: Deep Blue #1A2E52.

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Arc: Warm Gold #C9A84C, one stroke, round ends, no sharp angles.

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Arc path: clockwise spiral, 216° → −100° (316° of sweep),

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: radius 1.30 R → 0.70 R, so it starts outside the circle and

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: comes to rest inside it, at the base. It never leaves again.

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Width: 0.050 R at the tail, 0.150 R at the crown (t = 0.50), 0.085 R at rest.

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Knock-out: a 0.050 R gap is cut from the circle around the arc,

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: so the gold never touches the blue (a hook through the world,

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: not a ring painted on it).

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif
Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Small-size variant (under 32 px / 8 mm; floor 16 px / 5 mm):

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif
Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif
Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Entry is visible: the tail, outside, lower left.

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Varela Round', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', sans-serif

svg.text: Exit is not represented: there is no second arc.
